purpose: Adjudicate the consumed Ethereum September 4 threshold-ladder prefilter without refetch and explicitly separate the rule-consistent payout identity from independent-condition resolution risk.

payoff_adjudication.rule_consistent_identity: If every market applies the common Binance ETHUSDT close rule consistently, YES at lower threshold L plus NO at higher threshold H pays 1 pUSD when the close is at or below L, 2 pUSD when it is strictly above L and at or below H, and 1 pUSD when it is strictly above H.
unbound_resolution_risks: independent condition proposal or dispute divergence
payoff_adjudication.effect_on_current_decision: These risks can only weaken the package as a guaranteed-floor claim. The complete event already fails before books against the more optimistic rule-consistent one-pUSD floor, so the rejection is unchanged and no refetch is justified.

future_gate.displayed_prefilter: Require a distinct complete exact event and at least one rejection-only displayed package strictly below the optimistic rule-consistent floor.
future_gate.resolution_gate: Before acceptance or promotion, source-bind every leg's exceptional settlement cancellation proposal dispute and resolution semantics and price the residual independent-condition divergence and settlement-delay risk.
future_gate.execution_gate: Then require a separately frozen synchronized exact two-token depth batch, contract-bound fee schedule, minimum size, freshness, adverse-tick stress, capacity, orphan-fill unwind, and every external cost.

adjudication.reopen_only_on: a distinct active BTC ETH or SOL threshold ladder outside every consumed event with complete exact rules and a rejection-only displayed lower-YES plus higher-NO sum strictly below the optimistic rule-consistent floor, or a material fee rule resolution delay or execution change

prohibited_shortcuts: calling independent conditions an absolute guaranteed package without resolution-risk qualification
repeating the consumed event to repair the omitted wording
requesting books after the optimistic displayed floor already failed
cherry-picking the current BTC or SOL sibling ladder
using Gamma displayed prices as executable acceptance evidence
